environment.note: Apple M5 Max, 64 GB, no Docker, no sudo

semgrep.install: brew install semgrep; rule packs fetched once from https://semgrep.dev/c/p/<pack> into corpus/tools/semgrep-rules

pmd.install: brew install pmd (CPD only for C#)

codeql.install: brew install --cask codeql + codeql pack download codeql/csharp-queries; C# extractor run on an arm64 .NET 10 runtime through experiments/tools/codeql_arm64.sh (bundle ships x86-64 only, Rosetta 2 absent)

incomplete.reason: C# analysis requires SonarScanner for .NET wrapping an MSBuild build (dotnet build), which is out of scope for this agent (owned by the build/test agent); plain sonar-scanner does not analyse C#. Not attempted.

incomplete.tool: PMD rule engine (pmd check) for C#
incomplete.reason: PMD 7.29 has no C# rule module (valid languages: apex, ecmascript, html, java, jsp, kotlin, modelica, plsql, pom, scala, swift, velocity, visualforce, wsdl, xml, xsl); only CPD supports C#.

Ran in --local mode only (11 of 18 checks). The API-based checks (Code-Review, Maintained, Branch-Protection, CI-Tests, Contributors, Signed-Releases, CII-Best-Practices, Webhooks) need a GitHub token; the user's token was deliberately not used.

Runs (with --no-ignore; without it, it honours the enclosing lab repo's .gitignore and exits 128 'no package sources found'). It parses Directory.Packages.props but extracts 0 packages (no central-package-management support) and skips PackageReference items without a version, so on the real tree it only sees the Unity packages.config (no advisories): effectively no coverage of the real dependencies. Counted as no coverage, not as zero findings.
Run with --no-verification on purpose (verification would send discovered credentials to third-party APIs).

The bundled C# extractor is x86-64-only and Rosetta 2 is not installed (installing it needs admin rights and a licence acceptance). CodeQL was run through a framework-dependent arm64 shim; results should be equivalent but the setup is non-standard.
